configuration: Original workspace teacher, no engine/task/reward/action/observation edits
context: 40x32mm/50g cylinder, original grasp44, 16 finger actions, held wrists, four passive mimics; Isaac Sim6.1.0.0/Lab3.0.0rc1, v3 external clipped PD, 28-cache nominal privileged teacher

diagnostic_definitions.uncertainty: One fixed original-state rollout per checkpoint; no confidence interval or causal experiment
diagnostic_definitions.reward: Offline original Hora function on frozen evaluation control endpoints; canonical original-grasp pose reference; NOT recorded training rewards
diagnostic_definitions.plots: Every20th physics sample (100Hz), always retain terminal sample; control/reward curves at20Hz. Pose-rate diagnostic is the signed quaternion increment summed over each complete50ms control interval divided by .05s; no other smoothing.

figure_provenance.description: A/B compare full observed angle histories and common first5s. C/D align terminal50M angle and object height on separate axes; vertical line marks last sensor-visible hand contact. E shows software target saturation. F contrasts reported20M angular velocities at control endpoints with actual quaternion motion over complete50ms control intervals. Crosses mark actual observed endpoints, including wall-budget censoring.
